title: Save a small local preference
summary: A page can remember a small choice in localStorage.
introduction: A page can remember a small choice in localStorage. Your task: Change the theme value and read it back.
learningObjectives: Change the theme value and read it back.
Explain the example for save a small local preference

blocks.text: A page can remember a small choice in localStorage. This storage belongs to that browser and origin, not to a cloud account.

These examples belong in separate files on your own HTTPS or localhost site. Service workers need that trusted origin and cannot run in this site's sandbox. Use browser developer tools to inspect them.

blocks.title: Save a small local preference

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `localStorage` stores text for this origin and browser. Access can fail, and users can clear the saved values.

blocks.text: On a page where storage is allowed, the console shows dark. The catch handles blocked or unavailable storage.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Service workers do not have localStorage. Use it in page code, and never assume browser data is permanent.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the theme value and read it back.
